title: Automate changelog and onboard Lyra-14B v1.2 (perf profiles & metadata)
author: Priya Nair
description: Context: Onboarding Lyra-14B v1.2 into the model registry with performance profiles, metadata, and an automated changelog entry generator. Motivation: reduce manual release-note churn and ensure perf profiles are generated and validated as part of the PR pipeline. This PR introduces: 1) model metadata YAML for lyra-14b v1.2 (config, manifests, tags); 2) performance profiles (latency/throughput/seq-length buckets) and perf profile templates; 3) a small automation script (scripts/registry/generate_changelog.py) that consumes model metadata and produces a release note fragment under changelogs/; 4) CI job definitions to run the perf sanity tests and validate changelog output; 5) docs update for the onboarding checklist. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata (models/lyra-14b/v1.2/metadata.yaml) - [x] Add perf profiles (models/lyra-14b/v1.2/perf-profiles/*.json) - [x] Add changelog generator and tests - [x] Add CI workflow to run perf sanity and changelog validation - [x] Update onboarding docs and quickstart Notes on automation: generate_changelog.py is intentionally conservative: it validates that required metadata keys exist, renders a markdown fragment, and fails the job if the changelog fragment already exists or has conflicting model/version entries. The CI validates that the generated fragment compiles and that perf profiles meet minimum SLOs derived from historical baselines. Test plan: - Unit tests for generate_changelog.py included under tests/registry/test_changelog_generator.py - Perf sanity runs in CI (temporary small sample) - Manual verify of the generated changelogs/2026-02-17-lyra-14b-v1.2.md after merge Rollout/ops notes: - Registry sync job will pick up new metadata on next deployment cycle; ops can force a refresh via /admin/registry/refresh. - No runtime serving changes in this PR; rollout is metadata-only. Related: ENG-3421 for perf-profile naming, PM-1287 for release cadence.
